summary: Case study of a long-term commercial mortgage arranged for a UK student accommodation operator buying a new purpose-built student accommodation (PBSA) building in Birmingham. The borrower required a long-term commercial mortgage at 70% loan-to-value; it intended to complete the purchase with cash and then needed immediate access to a loan post-acquisition. Silver Oak Capital proposed a GBP 12 million facility from a Birmingham-based lender at 70% LTV, priced at 2.50% above the Bank Base Rate, over a 10-year term, interest-only, with a 1.75% bank fee. Challenges named in the case study: optimising the building's space and amenities for changing student needs, and meeting student housing regulations and safety standards. The search results did not reveal the final outcome/completion statement, timing (dates or speed of completion), the lender's name, or any client quote. Only a partial text of the page was returned.
